/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from lxml import etree
import os, tempfile, shutil

pptx_path = Path('/home/user/Desktop/9_1.pptx')
slide_name = 'ppt/slides/slide1.xml'
ns = {
    'p': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main',
    'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main',
}
A = ns['a']

with ZipFile(pptx_path, 'r') as zin:
    slide_xml = zin.read(slide_name)

root = etree.fromstring(slide_xml)
shape = None
for sp in root.xpath('.//p:sp', namespaces=ns):
    ph = sp.find('.//p:nvPr/p:ph', namespaces=ns)
    if ph is not None and ph.get('type') == 'title':
        shape = sp
        break
if shape is None:
    raise SystemExit('No title placeholder found on slide 1')

tx_body = shape.find('p:txBody', namespaces=ns)
for p in tx_body.findall('a:p', namespaces=ns):
    tx_body.remove(p)

p = etree.SubElement(tx_body, f'{{{A}}}p')
r = etree.SubElement(p, f'{{{A}}}r')
rpr = etree.SubElement(r, f'{{{A}}}rPr')
rpr.set('lang', 'en-US')
rpr.set('sz', '1800')
for tag in ('latin', 'ea', 'cs'):
    child = etree.SubElement(rpr, f'{{{A}}}{tag}')
    child.set('typeface', 'Microsoft JhengHei')
t = etree.SubElement(r, f'{{{A}}}t')
t.text = 'Happy Family'
end = etree.SubElement(p, f'{{{A}}}endParaRPr')
end.set('lang', 'en-US')
end.set('sz', '1800')
for tag in ('latin', 'ea', 'cs'):
    child = etree.SubElement(end, f'{{{A}}}{tag}')
    child.set('typeface', 'Microsoft JhengHei')

new_slide = etree.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)
fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pptx', dir=str(pptx_path.parent))
os.close(fd)
tmp_path = Path(tmp_name)
try:
    with ZipFile(pptx_path, 'r') as zin, ZipFile(tmp_path, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for item in zin.infolist():
            data = new_slide if item.filename == slide_name else zin.read(item.filename)
            zout.writestr(item, data)
    shutil.copystat(pptx_path, tmp_path)
    os.replace(tmp_path, pptx_path)
finally:
    if tmp_path.exists():
        tmp_path.unlink()
PY"
